title: Inventory outer and nested executable layers
summary: When an installer or launcher contains a second executable layer, classify both layers independently before selecting a maintenance strategy.

applicability: An installer or launcher exposes at least one nested executable payload.
detection: Package inventory shows executable layers with different architecture or runtime indicators.
negative_indicators: The artifact is a single executable with no nested payload or sidecar runtime.
procedure: Hash and classify the outer entrypoint and each nested executable as separate components.
verification: The component inventory records architecture, runtime clues, role, and hash relation for every executable layer.
rollback: Discard the derived inventory and return to the preserved package without modifying the baseline.
failure_signals: Extraction changes the preserved package or a nested component cannot be tied to reproducible package evidence.
stop_conditions: Use normal PE analysis when no nested executable layer is confirmed.
limitations: Static inventory does not prove which nested component runs or how authorization is enforced.
